description: Call this tool to re-encode an image as PNG, JPEG, BMP, GIF or TIFF. quality is JPEG-only. Transparency converted to JPEG flattens onto white; the answer says so. Free tier: sources up to 4 MP.

out_path.description: Name for the file to write; it comes back as a download link valid for one hour. The extension decides the output format; without a known one the input's format is kept

overwrite.description: Replace out_path if it already exists. Default false. Never allows an output to be one of the inputs

path.description: Name of an image uploaded with image_upload, or one this server wrote earlier

quality.description: JPEG quality 1-100, default 80. Ignored for the other formats

name: image_convert
title: Convert an image to another format
